messages:
dani: FYI partner AcmeSI asked for SOC2 report + pen test window before marketplace listing. Need owner for artifacts and a timeline. cc @josh @laura
josh: I can own the pen-test coordination. What scope do they need? infra + app or just control plane?
laura: they asked for infra + control plane. also will want redacted logs and an s3 bundle of config docs.
mike: We need to confirm whether we can share the SOC2 PDF or only the SOC2 summary. Legal prefers summary + attestation letter, full PDF via presigned URL with NDA.
dani: noted. timeline: partner is asking for a 2-week window starting May 10 for the pen test. @mike can legal sign off by EOD Friday?
mike: I'll review today. If we provide presigned URLs, we should enforce TTL 48h and require audit note in bundle metadata.
josh: For pen test access we need lab accounts and limited creds. Suggest: create temp IAM role with read-only, kill at TTL. ops can script creation.
akshay: ops here — we can spin up a burnbox and create role. need list of IPs and attack types (network vs app) to open firewall rules.
laura: partner will run network + app. I'll extract the list and post in thread.
dani: artifact list we need to produce:
- SOC2 summary + attestation
- presigned S3 bundle: config, infra diagrams, redacted logs
- penetration test rules of engagement (ROE)
- contact list and incident escalation

Please add owners inline.
josh: I'll take ROE and lab creds.
laura: I'll handle redaction and the S3 bundle contents. will draft redaction checklist:
``
PII patterns to scrub: email, ssn-like, ip addresses, api keys
Paths to include: /etc/redacted, /var/log/redact-*
Filename convention: partner_presign_YYYYMMDD.tar.gz
``` 
mike: legal owner on SOC2 delivery: @mike. We'll only hand full SOC2 via presign after NDA signed. Also need an attestation statement signed by security.
kevin-security-bot: Reminder: create a Jira ticket under PARTNER-SEC with checklist: NDA, presign, ROE, lab account TTL
dani: can someone take PARTNER-SEC ticket creation? I'm juggling roadmap deadlines.
laura: I'll create the Jira ticket and assign to josh/mike/ops. ETA 2 hours.
josh: ops, when lab is ready ping me and I'll add test users. also share terraform snippet for temp role.
akshay: will post terraform snippet in the ticket. also confirm the presign lifecycle: 48h, versioned bucket, encrypted with KMS.
dani: next steps recap:
- laura: create Jira, redaction checklist, S3 bundle owner
- josh: ROE + pen test coordination + test users
- akshay/ops: burnbox + temp IAM + terraform + presign setup
- mike: legal signoff + NDA template + attestation
- kevin-security-bot: create ticket reminder

If everyone agrees, we'll kick off tomorrow and target assets ready by May 6.
mike: agree. I'll prioritize NDA review today.
laura: agree. I'll start redaction pass and ping for review when done.
josh: sounds good. I'll book the pen-test calendar block for May 10-24.
kevin-security-bot: Incident note: make sure to log all external test IPs to security-audit log group.
